en: Let the Christ, the King of Israel, now come down from the cross, that we may see and believe. And they that were crucified with him reproached him.
tl: Bumaba ngayon mula sa krus ang Cristo, ang Hari ng Israel upang aming makita at paniwalaan.” At tinutuya rin siya ng mga kasama niyang nakapako sa krus.

en: And when the sixth hour was come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.
tl: Nang dumating ang tanghaling tapat, nagdilim sa buong lupain hanggang sa ikatlo ng hapon.

en: And at the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani? which is, being interpreted, My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me?
tl: Nang ikatlo ng hapon ay sumigaw si Jesus nang may malakas na tinig, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabacthani?” na ang kahulugan ay, “Diyos ko, Diyos ko, bakit mo ako pinabayaan?”

en: And some of them that stood by, when they heard it, said, Behold, he calleth Elijah.
tl: Nang marinig ito ng ilang nakatayo roon, ay sinabi nila, “Tingnan ninyo, tinatawag niya si Elias.”

en: And one ran, and filling a sponge full of vinegar, put it on a reed, and gave him to drink, saying, Let be; let us see whether Elijah cometh to take him down.
tl: Tumakbo ang isa, binasa ng suka ang isang espongha, inilagay sa isang tungkod, at ipinainom sa kanya na sinasabi, “Pabayaan ninyo; tingnan natin kung darating si Elias upang siya'y ibaba.”

en: And Jesus uttered a loud voice, and gave up the ghost.
tl: Si Jesus ay sumigaw nang malakas at nalagutan ng hininga.

en: And the veil of the temple was rent in two from the top to the bottom.
tl: Ang tabing ng templo ay nahati sa dalawa, mula sa itaas hanggang sa ibaba.

en: And when the centurion, who stood by over against him, saw that he so gave up the ghost, he said, Truly this man was the Son of God.
tl: Ang senturion na nakatayong malapit sa harap niya, nang makitang nalagot ang kanyang hininga sa ganitong paraan ay nagsabi, “Tunay na ang taong ito ay Anak ng Diyos.”

en: And there were also women beholding from afar: among whom were both Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;
tl: At mayroon din namang mga babae na nakatanaw mula sa malayo; kabilang sa kanila ay si Maria Magdalena, si Mariang ina ni Santiago na mas bata at ni Jose, at si Salome;

en: who, when he was in Galilee, followed him, and ministered unto him; and many other women that came up with him unto Jerusalem.
tl: na nang siya'y nasa Galilea, ay sumunod sa kanya at naglingkod sa kanya; at marami pang ibang mga babae na umahong kasama niya sa Jerusalem.

en: And when even was now come, because it was the Preparation, that is, the day before the sabbath,
tl: Nang magtakip-silim na, sapagkat noon ay araw ng Paghahanda, ang araw bago ang Sabbath,

en: there came Joseph of Arimathæa, a councillor of honorable estate, who also himself was looking for the kingdom of God; and he boldly went in unto Pilate, and asked for the body of Jesus.
tl: si Jose na taga-Arimatea, isang marangal na kagawad, na naghihintay rin ng kaharian ng Diyos ay may katapangang pumunta kay Pilato at hiningi ang bangkay ni Jesus.

en: And Pilate marvelled if he were already dead: and calling unto him the centurion, he asked him whether he had been any while dead.
tl: At nagtaka si Pilato na siya'y patay na. Ipinatawag niya ang senturion at itinanong niya sa kanya kung patay na nga siya.

en: And when he learned it of the centurion, he granted the corpse to Joseph.
tl: Nang malaman niya sa senturion, ipinagkaloob niya ang bangkay kay Jose.

en: And he bought a linen cloth, and taking him down, wound him in the linen cloth, and laid him in a tomb which had been hewn out of a rock; and he rolled a stone against the door of the tomb.
tl: At bumili si Jose ng isang telang lino at pagkababa sa kanya sa krus ay binalot siya ng telang lino at inilagay siya sa isang libingan na hinukay sa isang bato. At iginulong niya ang isang bato sa pintuan ng libingan.

en: And Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses beheld where he was laid.
tl: Nakita ni Maria Magdalena at ni Mariang ina ni Jose kung saan siya inilagay.

en: And when the sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome, bought spices, that they might come and anoint him.
tl: Nang makaraan ang Sabbath, sina Maria Magdalena, Mariang ina ni Santiago, at si Salome, ay bumili ng mga pabango upang sila'y pumunta roon at siya'y pahiran.

en: And very early on the first day of the week, they come to the tomb when the sun was risen.
tl: Pagka-umaga nang unang araw ng linggo, pagkasikat ng araw, pumunta sila sa libingan.

en: And they were saying among themselves, Who shall roll us away the stone from the door of the tomb?
tl: Kanilang sinabi sa isa't isa, “Sino kaya ang magpapagulong ng bato para sa atin mula sa pasukan ng libingan?”

en: and looking up, they see that the stone is rolled back: for it was exceeding great.
tl: Sa pagtanaw nila ay nakita nilang naigulong na ang bato na lubhang napakalaki.

en: And entering into the tomb, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, arrayed in a white robe; and they were amazed.
tl: At pagpasok nila sa libingan, kanilang nakita ang isang binata na nakabihis ng isang damit na maputi, nakaupo sa gawing kanan at sila'y nagtaka.

en: And he saith unto them, Be not amazed: ye seek Jesus, the Nazarene, who hath been crucified: he is risen; he is not here: behold, the place where they laid him!
tl: Ngunit sinabi niya sa kanila, “Huwag kayong magtaka; hinahanap ninyo si Jesus na taga-Nazaret na ipinako sa krus. Siya'y muling binuhay. Wala siya rito. Tingnan ninyo ang dakong pinaglagyan nila sa kanya!

en: But go, tell his disciples and Peter, He goeth before you into Galilee: there shall ye see him, as he said unto you.
tl: Subalit humayo kayo, sabihin ninyo sa kanyang mga alagad at kay Pedro na siya'y mauuna sa inyo sa Galilea. Doon ninyo siya makikita, ayon sa sinabi niya sa inyo.”

en: And they went out, and fled from the tomb; for trembling and astonishment had come upon them: and they said nothing to any one; for they were afraid.
tl: At sila'y nagsilabas at nagsitakas mula sa libingan, sapagkat sila'y sinidlan ng sindak at pagkamangha, at wala silang sinabi kaninuman sapagkat sila'y natakot.

en: Now when he was risen early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast out seven demons.
tl: [At ang lahat ng mga iniutos sa kanila ay sinabi ng maiksi sa mga nasa palibot ni Pedro. At pagkatapos si Jesus mismo ay nagsugo sa pamamagitan nila, mula sa silangan hanggang kanluran, ang banal at walang hanggang proklamasyon ng walang katapusang kaligtasan.]

en: She went and told them that had been with him, as they mourned and wept.
tl: [Nang siya nga'y magbangon nang unang araw ng linggo ay una siyang nagpakita kay Maria Magdalena, na mula sa kanya'y pitong demonyo ang pinalayas niya.

en: And they, when they heard that he was alive, and had been seen of her, disbelieved.
tl: Siya'y lumabas at ibinalita sa mga naging kasama ni Jesus, samantalang sila'y nagluluksa at tumatangis.

en: And after these things he was manifested in another form unto two of them, as they walked, on their way into the country.
tl: Ngunit nang kanilang mabalitaan na siya'y buháy at nakita ni Magdalena ay ayaw nilang maniwala.

en: And they went away and told it unto the rest: neither believed they them.
tl: Pagkatapos ng mga ito ay nagpakita siya sa ibang anyo sa dalawa sa kanila noong sila'y naglalakad patungo sa bukid.

en: And afterward he was manifested unto the eleven themselves as they sat at meat; and he upbraided them with their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they believed not them that had seen him after he was risen.
tl: At sila'y bumalik at ipinagbigay-alam ito sa mga iba ngunit hindi rin sila naniwala.

en: And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to the whole creation.
tl: At pagkatapos siya'y nagpakita sa labing-isa samantalang sila'y nakaupo sa hapag-kainan; sila'y kanyang pinagsabihan dahil sa kawalan nila ng pananampalataya at katigasan ng puso, sapagkat hindi nila pinaniwalaan ang mga nakakita sa kanya pagkatapos na siya'y muling mabuhay.

en: He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved; but he that disbelieveth shall be condemned.
tl: At sinabi niya sa kanila, “Humayo kayo sa buong sanlibutan, at inyong ipangaral ang ebanghelyo sa lahat ng nilikha.

en: And these signs shall accompany them that believe: in my name shall they cast out demons; they shall speak with new tongues;
tl: Ang sumasampalataya at mabautismuhan ay maliligtas; ngunit ang hindi sumasampalataya ay parurusahan.

en: they shall take up serpents, and if they drink any deadly thing, it shall in no wise hurt them; they shall lay hands on the sick, and they shall recover.
tl: At ang mga tandang ito ay tataglayin ng mga nananampalataya: sa paggamit ng aking pangalan ay magpapalayas sila ng mga demonyo, magsasalita sila ng mga bagong wika;

en: So then the Lord Jesus, after he had spoken unto them, was received up into heaven, and sat down at the right hand of God.
tl: sila'y hahawak ng mga ahas, at kung makainom sila ng bagay na nakamamatay, hindi ito makakasama sa kanila, ipapatong nila ang kanilang mga kamay sa mga maysakit, at sila'y gagaling.”

en: And they went forth, and preached everywhere, the Lord working with them, and confirming the word by the signs that followed. Amen.
tl: Kaya't ang Panginoong Jesus nga, pagkatapos na siya'y magsalita sa kanila ay iniakyat sa langit at lumuklok sa kanan ng Diyos.
